description: P3-D0b step 0, version 2. Polygons drawn by eye from snapshots I actually viewed (Read tool, one image per call), normalised x,y in [0,1] from top-left, FROZEN before any v2 scoring. Supersedes crossing_door_reference_frigate.json (v1 was drawn without seeing the images). Cameras resolved via entity registry (platform frigate, client frigate-f2, unique_id suffix = Frigate camera name) and the fixture events' after.camera; door groups from the integration's configured egress map as used in run 1.
snapshot_overlay_clock: 2026-11-15 04:51:18 PM, overcast daylight, no people in frame

madrone_g6_entry.seen: Black-framed glass door/wall runs down the whole right edge (x>~0.82). Doormat at bottom right (x 0.45-0.87, y 0.78-1.0) abuts the glass. Inside = to the right (behind the glass); outside = left (lawn, stepping stones, walkway). Polygon = glass door face plus the mat in front of it. Occlusion: stone pier in the middle hides nothing relevant but a person walking along the wall at x 0.4-0.8, y<0.7 is on stone, not at a door. Strong overexposure upper left.

front_door_aerial.seen: Overhead view down a walled entry: stepping-stone path from top, paved porch, black mat with doormat at x 0.32-0.52, y 0.75-0.97, black door frame/threshold along the bottom edge (y ~0.96-1.0, x 0.25-0.62). Inside = below the bottom edge (off frame); outside = up the path. Occlusion: the door itself and anything inside is below the frame; walls left and right are solid stone.

garage_a.seen: Interior view from above: the glass sectional garage door spans the top (x 0.20-0.85, to y ~0.28). Inside = the floor below; outside = above the top edge (off frame). Sofa right, boxes and batteries left, shoe rack bottom left. A person crossing outside<->inside passes through the top strip. Other doors (left wall) are not the door group's threshold.

doorbell_lite.seen: Exterior view along the garage face: glass garage door fills the right edge from about y 0.40 down (door face left edge x ~0.72), paver driveway apron centre-left, lawn and road beyond. Outside = driveway (left); inside = behind the glass (right). Polygon = the garage door face. Occlusion: eave and pier at top right; fisheye distortion bends the door edge.

door_contacts._rule: Mapped by registry area: the contact or cover whose area equals the door group's cameras' area (entity registry area_id, else device area_id) and device_class door/garage/opening.

front.why: never reported on (open) in the recorder window

not_mapped_by_registry.binary_sensor.elkm1_front_door: platform elkm1, 128 on/off rows, but registry area is AV Closet (hub device), so it cannot be tied to the Front Porch by registry; reported as an operator question only
not_mapped_by_registry.binary_sensor.doorlock_kwikset_zwave_fro: area Entry Way; only state on in the window
